name: FUN_WF_PARTICIPANTS
description: This table contains participants created for the approval setup uploaded through UI or spreadsheet.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Participant identifier and primary key.

columns.name: STAGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference to FUN_WF_STAGES table.

columns.name: PARENT_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Parent participant identifier to represent the participants in a sequential order.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier that the participants are at the same level and in parallel to each other.

columns.name: PARENT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Parent participant group identifier to represent the participant group in a sequential order.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_KEY
columns.description: Participant key as represented in the resource bundle.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_NAME
columns.description: Participant name on the BPM worklist application.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of the participant. Valid values are serial, parallel, single, and FYI.

columns.name: IGNORE_PARTICIPANT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the participant is ignored.

columns.name: VOTE_OUTCOME_CODE
columns.description: Outcome of the approval process when the minimum voting percentage has been achieved. This is only applicable to parallel type participants.

columns.name: VOTE_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Minimum voting percentage to be achieved for making approval decision on the task. This is only applicable to parallel type participants.

columns.name: DEFAULT_OUTCOME_CODE
columns.description: Default outcome of the approval process when the minimum voting percentage has been achieved. This is only applicable to parallel type participants.

columns.name: OUTCOME_TRIGGER_POLICY
columns.description: Policy that decides when to trigger the voting outcome. This could be when minimum voting percentage is met or when all the votes are received. This is only applicable to parallel type participants.

columns.name: SKIP_RULE
columns.description: Rule to specify when the whole participant evaluation can be skipped during runtime.

columns.name: RULESET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the rule set within the participant.

columns.name: RULESET_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the rule set defined within a participant.

columns.name: RULESET_START_DATE
columns.description: Effective start date of the rule set in DB timezone.

columns.name: RULESET_END_DATE
columns.description: Effective end date of the rule set in DB timezone.

columns.name: RULESET_ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Value to indicate whether ruleset is active or not.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
